title: AllocationPolicyArtifact
description: Canonical output of optimizer-svc multi-persona allocation synthesis for one capital pool and scope.

artifact_id.description: Stable identifier for the produced allocation policy artifact.

capital_pool_id.description: Capital pool governed by this allocation policy.

scope_ref.description: Deployment or universe scope for this artifact, such as paper, canary, live, or a universe reference.

sponsor_persona_id.description: Single explicit sponsor persona selected for this pool and scope.

synthesis_method.description: Synthesis method that produced this artifact.

target_weights.description: Canonical target weight map for the optimizer to solve within. Semantic validation also requires the sum to be no greater than 1.0.

created_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp when the artifact was produced.

constraints_bundle.description: Constraint bundle supplied to the synthesis run, such as max weight, forbidden family, or environment controls.

risk_budget.description: Optional normalized risk budget supplied to the synthesis run.

provenance_refs.description: PersonaAllocationProposal ids that formed the artifact provenance.

conflict_resolution_log_id.description: ConflictResolutionLog id that explains veto, weighting, sponsor, and committee decisions.
